_comment: The application pages global search can find. Every url must be a route of frontend/src/app/router.tsx (frontend test searchRoutes.test.ts checks it). audience: who sees the page (ANONYMOUS = not signed in, or a role). permission: also needed, when set. perHotel: the url has {hotelId} and is shown once per hotel the manager runs.
